text:
ana: Quick sync — CloudVendor has asked us to onboard a new "galapagos" region into their marketplace for our Dedicated product. They want entitlement/SKU mappings, initial quotas, and KMS details. Looping in @liam @olivia @maria @sachin. Core asks: expected capacity (QPS/concurrency), GPU type preference, timeline, and legal requirements.

liam: Can we get their expected QPS and concurrency? Also which GPU? A100 or H100? That changes capacity and scheduling.

olivia: From infra side, realistic initial shapes are either 4x H100 nodes (preferred perf) or 12x A100 nodes (cost tradeoff). Need network perf, boot disk size, and expected model seq lengths to size KV cache.

sachin: For marketplace SKU mapping they want separate compute SKU + model-license SKU. My suggestion: two starter SKUs named `redwood-dedicated-galapagos-h100-4` and `redwood-dedicated-galapagos-a100-12`, with on-demand + 1/6/12 month reserved tiers.

maria: Legal flag: SOC2 addendum + data residency clause required for Galapagos. I can draft the addendum but need partner legal contact + their marketplace T&Cs. Also confirm whether they require specific DPA language.

ana: I already have partner contact (Carlos) and asked for T&Cs. They requested draft entitlement docs by EOD Friday and asked if we can go-live in mid-May (their marketing window).

liam: Mid-May is tight. We need vendor quota approval and infra validation. Propose a soft launch/canary 2024-05-21 with a 1 H100 canary fleet. Full launch after we validate telemetry.

olivia: I can run driver/AMI validation and a smoke test next Tue if we get a test entitlement with 1x H100 allocated. Please request a short-lived test quota from CloudVendor.

ana: Requested the test entitlement this morning — partner confirmed they can provision a test SKU tomorrow and will share access info.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled infra-smoke-tests/galapagos -> Tue 09:00 UTC

sachin: I’ll draft the marketplace listing copy + pricing options. Quick thought: because of constrained capacity we might start with a ~15% premium on list price and reduce as we scale. Thoughts?

maria: Include KMS flow and key ownership clearly in the listing. Customers will ask about control + audit logs; add a short FAQ bullet.

liam: Action items for next run: I’ll confirm capacity numbers and expected QPS by Monday EOD. Olivia will run smoke on Tue. Maria to prepare addendum by Thu. Sachin to share listing draft by Wed. Ana will keep partner sync and timelines. If any blocker, tag me and escalate.

ana: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for Galapagos marketplace onboarding. Will post partner contact info and the entitlement token once I have it. :wave:
